storyboard_notes: Nine shots, 31.7 s. Tara's sheet is attached, first, to seven of them (all but s02 and s07). Her face is the subject of six (s01, s03, s04, s05, s06, s09): front-on, low angle with green uplight, right profile, extreme close-up, wider with a foreground blur, and backlit near-silhouette. s08 uses the sheet for her hand and sleeve only.

Imran is a voice only until s06. He is first seen, out of focus, on the word driver, and his eyes are first seen in the mirror in s07. The script puts his eyes in the mirror in b1 and b3 as well; with a nine-shot ceiling those two mirror cutaways were dropped so that b6 could keep both the mirror and the door lock.
The script cuts back to Tara for the grin dying at the end of b2. Here the insert holds for all of b2 with her whisper over it, and the dead grin is delivered by s03 under the green phone light.
b4 is cut in two on the interruption (end of l06, start of l07) so neither half runs past 5 s. The longest shot is s06 at 6.0 s (the whole of l08), played as one continuous push-in.

Key props (duffel bag, keypad phone, bag contents) are described in words in every prompt, copied from style.json key_props, and are not attached as images: the brief for this file limits refs to character sheets and location plates, three at most. If props drift between s01, s02, s03 and s09, the first fix is to add duffel_bag, bag_contents or keypad_phone as an extra reference and label it in the prompt.

Door-lock knobs are UP in s01, s03, s04, s06 and s07 and DOWN in s08 and s09. Wipers are still in s07 and never move in any shot: the b7 wiper sweep was cut from the script. The phone screen is never shown lit to camera.

Stills cannot lip-sync, so lines are kept off moving mouths where possible: l02, l04 and l10 are Imran off-screen; l05, l07 and l08 are the unseen caller; of Tara's four lines, l03 plays over the bag insert and l09 over the hand insert, and only l01 (mid-laugh) and l06 (profile, lips just parted) play on her face.

Continuity keeper (S4): the plate labels in s03, s08 and s09 said 'Match them exactly' while the plates show lock knobs UP, sedan lights off and no green glow. Each now names its exception (s03 green phone glow; s08 knob DOWN; s09 knob DOWN and headlights on behind) so the reference does not override the shot. See continuity.json.

Storyboard revision (S7) after the script rewrite: total 31.7 s (s06 goes from 4.8 to 6.0 s for l08's new target); action text re-quoted from the current script (l03, l04, l07, l08); s01 has her already pulling the zip and is no longer out of breath; the wiper sweep is gone from s09; s02 no longer says 'No people' while showing her lap. Line ids, beat ids, refs, light states and the nine-shot order are unchanged. See review-notes.json storyboard_fixes.

Screen-direction map (S7): the scene's line runs from Tara (rear left) to Imran (front right). Every frontal camera (s01, s03, s05, s06, s09) sits at the front of the cabin on the kerb side of that line: the driver is frame left, the neon door window is frame right, and the phone at her right ear is on the left of her face as we see it. s07 is her point of view along the line (driver frame right, a normal reverse). s04 and the s08 insert look across from the rear-right seat, which is the far side of the line: in s04 the front of the car is frame right. s04 stays there because the script's b4 image (right profile, phone visible at her ear, neon window behind her) can only be seen from that side. Do not add a sideways eye-line to s03, s04 or s05.
